questions.q: How many souls of the house of Jacob came into Egypt?
questions.explain: A score is twenty; three score is sixty, and ten more makes seventy.

questions.q: Why did Joseph tell his brethren to say they were shepherds?
choices: To hide that they were his brothers
Every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians, so they would dwell apart in Goshen
questions.explain: The Hyksos shepherd kings had ruled Egypt; naming their trade set Israel apart in fertile Goshen.
